extracted.intended_audience: historians, members of the American Historical Association, and prospective applicants for AHA awards, grants, and fellowships
extracted.subtask_short: applying for AHA awards and grants
extracted.subtask_description: A landing/overview page describing the American Historical Association's awards, prizes, grants, subgrant programs, and related deadlines and selection processes; intended to guide historians about available recognition and funding opportunities and where to find detailed eligibility and application instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Awards for Publications — quality of work
rubrics_metrics.description: These prizes honor exceptional books, articles, films, and digital works on a wide range of historical topics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions are due May 15, 2026. See 'Learn More' for details about specific prize criteria, eligibility, and how to apply. (Original wording: "These prizes honor exceptional books, articles, films, and digital works on a wide range of historical topics.")

rubrics_metrics.name: Awards for Scholarly and Professional Distinction — distinguished contributions
rubrics_metrics.description: These awards recognize individuals and groups who have made distinguished contributions to the discipline of history.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions are due May 15, 2026. See 'Learn More' for specific award names, nomination procedures, and eligibility requirements. (Original wording: "These awards recognize individuals and groups who have made distinguished contributions to the discipline of history.")

rubrics_metrics.name: AHA Research Grants — advancing historical study
rubrics_metrics.description: Each year, the American Historical Association awards several research grants with the aim of advancing the study and exploration of history in a variety of subject areas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See details about the eligibility and application process for each grant on the AHA website. (Original wording: "Each year, the American Historical Association awards several research grants with the aim of advancing the study and exploration of history in a variety of subject areas.")

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission deadline (procedural requirement)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The May 15, 2026 deadline explicitly applies to the 'Awards for Publications' and 'Awards for Scholarly and Professional Distinction' listings on this page; applicants should consult the specific award pages for any differing deadlines or additional timeline requirements. (Original wording: "Submissions are due May 15, 2026.")

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection process — volunteer committee review
rubrics_metrics.description: Volunteer committee members (more than 100) supported by AHA staff collect and review nominations, announce prizewinners, and honor recipients at the annual meeting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection is carried out by volunteer committees over several months prior to the awards ceremony; this implies peer/committee evaluation rather than purely administrative selection. (Original wording: "more than 100 volunteer committee members, supported by AHA staff, work for months to collect and review nominations, announce prizewinners, and, finally, honor the recipients at the annual meeting.")

rubrics_metrics.name: AHA Subgrant Programs — administered subgrants
rubrics_metrics.description: The AHA administers subgrant programs (listed as 'AHA Subgrant Programs').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 'Learn More' links provide program-specific eligibility, goals, and application instructions; no detailed criteria are provided on this overview page. (Original wording: "AHA Subgrant Programs")

rubrics_metrics.name: Teaching with Primary Sources (TPS) Mid-Atlantic/US Territories Region — program aims
rubrics_metrics.description: The TPS grant program, in partnership with the Library of Congress, furthers the Library’s mission to engage, inspire, and inform audiences across the country with a universal and enduring source of knowledge and creativity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a partnership-driven grant program; applicants should follow the linked 'Learn More' for region- and program-specific application and eligibility details. (Original wording: "The TPS grant program furthers the Library’s mission to engage, inspire, and inform audiences across the country with a universal and enduring source of knowledge and creativity.")

rubrics_metrics.name: Discontinued awards and grants — historical record
rubrics_metrics.description: The AHA has provided a wide variety of awards, grants, and fellowships that were limited programs or have since been discontinued.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed for archival/reference purposes; discontinued programs are not currently available for application. (Original wording: "The AHA has provided a wide variety of awards, grants, and fellowships that were limited programs or have since been discontinued.")
